Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

The Americas Compliance team is hiring a Senior Compliance Manager to own compliance for OKXICE TSV and for the joint venture's new broker-dealer. OKXICE TSV is the tokenized securities venue run by the OKX and Intercontinental Exchange joint venture under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, and it lets eligible US users trade tokenized US-listed stocks on-chain. The joint venture is also registering a broker-dealer with FINRA. You'll be the main person accountable for meeting the exemption's ongoing conditions and for taking the broker-dealer through FINRA membership and into operation. You'll work closely with Legal, Finance, Product, Web3 Risk Control and our AML, Sanctions and Surveillance teams, as well as outside counsel and the broker-dealer's clearing firm. These are new businesses, so you'll help build the programs as well as run them.

What You'll Be Doing

•

Own the compliance program for the venue's SEC exemption, including tracking each condition, testing controls and keeping records ready for regulatory examination.

•

Manage the venue's public notice: review revisions, control versions, and make sure the notice matches how the product actually works. This includes corrections and material-change filings within the required deadlines.

•

Run the issuer notice process from start to finish, including tracking delivery, handling objections and confirming each stock's listing date.

•

Track and monitor TSV limits on an ongoing basis, including per-stock and volume limits against consolidated market data, periodic tier rechecks, trading halts and eligible stablecoins. Escalate breaches, significant operational events and required SEC notifications.

•

Oversee participant onboarding and ongoing wallet maintenance and monitoring, including KYC/KYB, daily sanctions and on-chain wallet rescreening, keeping wallet-to-participant records current, and issuing and revoking the soulbound token (SBT) credential that grants access.

•

Lead the broker-dealer through the FINRA new membership application, including Form BD, the business plan and supporting exhibits, responses to FINRA staff requests, and the membership interview.

•

Coordinate the evidence FINRA needs before approval, such as the officer and director structure, authorized signatories on the broker-dealer's bank accounts, bank statements, the independent auditor engagement, the clearing agreement, and flow-of-funds and demo materials.

•

Build the broker-dealer's compliance program, including written supervisory procedures, the supervisory control system, an AML program under FINRA Rule 3310 with customer identification procedures, and books and records under SEC Rules 17a-3 and 17a-4.

•

Once the broker-dealer is approved, run its ongoing compliance, including the annual certification under FINRA Rule 3130, supervisory control testing under Rule 3120, regulatory filings, and FINRA examinations and inquiries. Work with the Financial and Operations Principal on net capital and FOCUS reporting.

What We Look For In You

•

8+ years of compliance experience at a FINRA-registered broker-dealer, exchange, alternative trading system (ATS) or digital asset firm, with direct experience of SEC- and FINRA-regulated activity.

•

FINRA Series 24 (General Securities Principal) registration, or the ability to qualify within an agreed period after joining.

•

Hands-on experience with a FINRA new membership or continuing membership application, including preparing the application and handling FINRA staff questions through to approval.

•

Working knowledge of the federal securities laws and FINRA rules that apply to broker-dealers and trading venues, such as Regulation ATS, Regulation NMS, the net capital and customer protection rules, and market manipulation rules, plus the ability to apply them to new market structures.

•

Experience building or running compliance programs under regulatory conditions, exemptive relief or no-action positions.

•

Familiarity with how blockchain-based trading works, including self-custodied wallets, smart contracts, liquidity pools and on-chain screening.

•

Strong drafting skills, with experience turning complex technical or legal detail into clear public disclosures and procedures.

•

Sound judgment and the ability to work with Product, Engineering and Legal teams across time zones.

Nice to Haves

•

Experience with tokenized securities, transfer agents or digital asset broker-dealers.

•

Exposure to OFAC sanctions programs and blocked property handling for on-chain assets.

•

Experience reporting to a board or joint venture governance body.

•

Series 14 (Compliance Official) registration.

•

Experience working with a clearing firm under a fully disclosed clearing arrangement.

•

A JD or a similar legal background.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

•

Various team building programs and company events

•

Wellness and meal allowances

•

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

•

More that we love to tell you along the process!

About the Opportunity

The work of the blockchain parsing team involves structuring on-chain data. This means taking all the raw data from the blockchain and, through business modeling, computation, transformation, and other operations, converting it into the data required by various business applications (such as wallets, explorers, CeFi, etc.). This process involves parsing on-chain data from hundreds of blockchains with different architectures, including EVM, UTXO, Cosmos, Move, and more, as well as scheduling these operations. It also encompasses the management of complete historical data for each blockchain, reaching the scale of petabytes (PB) of data.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Responsible for researching various blockchain architectures and on-chain data parsing.

• Maintain good communication with the team, provide rational suggestions for requirements, and ensure the development work progresses smoothly as planned; ensure the system meets performance, scalability, and security requirements.

• Responsible for database design, system design, API interface design, and external system integration.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the entire pipeline; optimize and improve the availability and capacity of online services, and handle unexpected online issues.

Selling point of the team

• Gain exposure to the latest public blockchain technologies in the industry.

• Work with and manage the largest volume of on-chain data in the industry, which involves hundreds of blockchains.

• Our team is a core part of the company’s infrastructure. You’ll gain insight into how complex foundational services are built to support multiple business lines, including wallets, DeFi, CeFi, explorers, and tracking tools. Our approach is innovative and leading in the industry.

What We Look For In You

• Solid foundation in Java, with extensive experience in Java multithreading, concurrency, and network communication, and good coding practices.

• Familiar with common open-source projects or middleware (at least one or two), with source code experience being a plus, such as Kafka, RocketMQ, GRPC, Dubbo, Redis, MySQL, Elasticsearch (ES), caching mechanisms, Spring/SpringBoot, etc.

• Proficient in mainstream open-source application frameworks such as SpringBoot, SpringMVC, MyBatis, SpringCloud, etc.

• Experience in developing and designing large-scale data platforms.

• Strong learning ability, teamwork, and communication skills; proactive in thinking and capable of independent analysis and problem-solving.

• Understanding of Web3, public blockchain business, and technology; relevant work experience is a plus.

• Strong sense of responsibility, ownership mindset, and an exploratory spirit.

L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

Wellness and meal allowances

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

The Strategic Markets and Global Marketing teams are responsible for accelerating sustainable growth across OKX’s priority markets. We work across regions and functions to identify opportunities, develop market strategies, strengthen execution, and build repeatable operating models that can scale globally.

We are looking for a Chief of Staff to serve as a trusted strategic and operational partner to the Executive Vice President of Global Markets and Marketing. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of strategy, market expansion, business performance, and organizational execution.

You will translate strategic priorities into clear operating plans, drive high-priority cross-functional initiatives, improve decision-making through rigorous analysis, and ensure alignment across regional and global teams. You will also act as a connective layer between the Strategic Markets and Global Marketing leadership teams and key partners across Product, Marketing, Business Development, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and other functions.

The ideal candidate combines strong commercial judgment, analytical rigor, executive presence, and hands-on execution. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions, and taking ownership of complex initiatives from initial problem definition through to measurable results.

What You’ll Be Doing

Strategic Planning and Execution

•

Partner directly with the Executive Vice President of Global Markets and Marketing to define priorities, develop strategic plans, and translate objectives into clear initiatives, milestones, and areas of accountability.

•

Drive the annual and quarterly planning processes for Strategic Markets and Global Marketing, ensuring alignment between regional priorities and broader company objectives.

•

Lead complex, high-priority initiatives spanning multiple markets, business units, and functional teams.

•

Identify execution risks, dependencies, and organizational gaps early, and work with stakeholders to resolve them.

•

Ensure key decisions are translated into action, with clear ownership, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

Market Growth and Business Performance

•

Develop data-driven analyses and recommendations regarding market expansion, investment allocation, customer growth, partnerships, and other strategic opportunities.

•

Monitor market performance, commercial trends, competitive developments, and emerging risks across priority markets.

•

Partner with regional leaders to assess performance, identify growth opportunities, and strengthen local market strategies.

•

Build business cases and scenario analyses to support resource allocation and investment decisions.

•

Help develop repeatable market-entry and growth playbooks that can be applied across regions while accounting for local market conditions.

Operating Cadence and Governance

•

Establish and continuously improve the operating cadence for Strategic Markets and Global Marketing, including leadership meetings, business reviews, planning sessions, and regional performance reviews.

•

Develop dashboards and management reports that provide leadership with a clear view of performance, priorities, risks, and required decisions.

•

Create effective governance mechanisms for cross-functional initiatives, ensuring appropriate escalation and timely decision-making.

•

Maintain disciplined follow-through on leadership decisions, commitments, and strategic initiatives.

•

Improve the quality and flow of information among regional teams, functional partners, and senior leadership.

Executive Advisory and Decision Support

•

Serve as a trusted thought partner to the Executive Vice President of Global Markets and Marketing on strategic, commercial, operational, and organizational matters.

•

Synthesize complex information into clear insights, recommendations, executive briefings, and materials that support decision-making.

•

Prepare presentations, business reviews, strategic updates, and other materials for senior leadership.

•

Represent the Strategic Markets and Global Marketing leadership teams in selected meetings and initiatives, ensuring continuity, alignment, and follow-through.

Cross-Functional Leadership

•

Build strong relationships with regional leaders and global stakeholders across Product, Marketing, Business Development, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, HR, and Communications.

•

Act as a connector across teams, clarifying objectives, resolving competing priorities, and removing barriers to execution.

•

Lead special projects and time-sensitive initiatives that do not have a natural owner elsewhere in the organization.

•

Support organizational planning, resource prioritization, and ways of working as the Strategic Markets and Global Marketing function evolves.

•

Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, transparency, and high performance.

What We Look For In You

•

Experience in strategy, business operations, management consulting, investment banking, technology, fintech, financial services, or a similarly fast-paced and analytical environment.

•

Demonstrated experience partnering directly with senior executives and influencing leaders across multiple functions and markets.

•

A strong track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution.

•

Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect market insights, customer needs, business performance, and company priorities.

•

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience developing business cases, performance analyses, and executive-level recommendations.

•

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex topics into clear decisions and action plans.

•

Strong executive presence and the ability to build trust with stakeholders across different functions, cultures, and levels of seniority.

•

High ownership, sound judgment, and a willingness to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels.

•

Ability to thrive in ambiguity, adapt quickly, and maintain momentum in a rapidly changing environment.

•

High integrity and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive information.

•

Professional fluency in English.

Nice to Haves

•

Experience in crypto, fintech, digital assets, payments, or another highly regulated and rapidly evolving industry.

•

Experience supporting international expansion or managing initiatives across multiple geographic markets.

•

Prior experience as a Chief of Staff, strategy leader, business operations leader, or regional operator.

•

Familiarity with go-to-market strategy, growth planning, partnerships, and regional operating models.

•

Additional language capabilities relevant to OKX’s international markets.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

•

L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company events

•

Wellness and meal allowances

•

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

•

More that we love to tell you along the process!

Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets and consumer trading.  - Review and disposition surveillance alerts across our regulated markets, and record the reasoning behind each decision clearly enough that someone else can follow it.

 - Investigate escalated behaviour end to end: gather the data, reconstruct what happened, and write it up for presentation to senior compliance stakeholders.

 - Assess referrals raised from across the business and externally, and take forward the ones that warrant it.

 - Draft suspicious transaction and order reports and suspicious activity reports.

 - Produce management information and regulatory reporting for the entities we cover.

 - Contribute to surveillance platform and tooling work, including bringing new products and data sources into scope and testing that detection behaves as intended.

 - Use AI and automation tools to speed up evidence-gathering and case reconstruction, with human judgement over the final call. 

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - At least 2 years experience in trade surveillance, market abuse investigation or trading conduct inside a regulated firm, such as an exchange, broker-dealer, trading venue, bank or comparable regulated trading business.

 - Working knowledge of the core market abuse typologies, for example spoofing, layering, wash trading, insider dealing, front running and ramping.

 - Experience reviewing and dispositioning surveillance alerts, and writing up what you found to a standard others can rely on.

 - Clear, evidence-first written communication. Your case files and escalations will sometimes be read by auditors and regulators without you in the room to explain them.

 - Comfort using generative AI and other automation tools to improve the speed and quality of investigative work, while maintaining the oversight that regulated casework requires.

 - Based in the UK, Ireland, Cyprus, Malta, Romania or Canada, with fluency in English.

 - Exposure to crypto-asset markets is welcomed but not required.

 - Hands-on use of a surveillance platform such as Scila, Nasdaq SMARTS, Eventus or NICE Actimize.

 - Experience drafting suspicious transaction and order reports or suspicious activity reports.

 - Electronic communications surveillance experience.

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

Lead infrastructure architecture and core platform development for the AI Native era, covering CI/CD, AIOps, observability, and monorepo engineering. Build platforms that support multiple programming languages across host-based and containerized environments.

Use platform engineering, intelligent tooling, and automated quality controls to enable developers and AI agents to work together, improving developer productivity, software quality, and production reliability.

What You’ll Be Doing

•

Infrastructure Architecture and Evolution: Define platform architecture, technical standards, and roadmaps, balancing scalability, reliability, security, and cost. Lead critical component design, hands-on development, and implementation across teams.

•

AI Native Engineering Capabilities: Connect code, documentation, dependencies, test results, and runtime data into usable engineering context. Expose capabilities through APIs, CLIs, and SDKs for developers and agents to understand and review code, run tests, and resolve issues. Establish task evaluations, output validation, and execution permissions.

•

Infrastructure for Multiple Languages: Build extensible toolchains, dependency management, testing, and delivery capabilities for ecosystems such as Go, Java, Python, C++, and Rust. Use standard protocols and SDKs to support communication across languages, interface compatibility, and consistent telemetry, reducing platform integration effort.

•

Monorepo and Build Systems: Define repository structure, module boundaries, dependency policies, and code ownership to support changes across modules and independent service releases. Apply practices from systems such as Bazel and Buck2 to deliver incremental and reproducible builds, affected-test selection, remote caching, and remote execution.

•

CI/CD and Quality Engineering: Build shared platforms for builds, tests, artifacts, and releases across hosts and containers. Improve configuration governance, automated quality gates, progressive delivery, health verification, and rollback to shorten delivery cycles and reduce change risk.

•

Observability and Reliability: Unify metrics, logs, traces, and profiling, linking telemetry to code, configuration, dependencies, and deployments. Establish SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and alerting practices, and feed production findings back into engineering quality improvements.

•

AIOps and Automated Remediation: Combine telemetry, topology, change history, and operational knowledge to enable anomaly detection, incident investigation, root cause analysis, and controlled remediation. Use incident replay, evaluation, and feedback to reduce recovery time and repetitive operational work.

What We Look For In You

•

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. At least 8 years of infrastructure or platform engineering experience, including 3 years in architecture or technical leadership.

•

Deep expertise in at least one of CI/CD, build systems, observability, or AIOps, with experience designing, implementing, and operating large production systems.

•

Strong knowledge of Linux, networking, distributed systems, and troubleshooting. Experience with deployment, configuration management, resource isolation, and production diagnostics in host-based and Kubernetes environments.

•

Experience building infrastructure for multiple languages, with an understanding of toolchain, dependency, and runtime differences. Ability to design shared platform interfaces and extensible language integrations.

•

Familiarity with open-source infrastructure practices originating at Google or Meta, such as build and dependency management with Bazel or Buck2, or cross-language communication and interface contracts with gRPC and Protocol Buffers. Experience evaluating, integrating, or optimizing relevant technologies.

•

Experience with automated testing, quality gates, and release engineering, using observability and reliability measures to improve delivery workflows.

•

Practical experience applying LLMs or agents to engineering workflows, including context construction, tool use, task orchestration, evaluation, and safe execution.

• Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, Java, C++, or Rust, with strong hands-on coding and debugging skills. Ability to drive implementation through design reviews, technical guidance, and collaboration across teams.

Nice to Haves

•

Experience at Google, Meta, or other leading technology companies, and a background in infrastructure, developer productivity, or AI Native engineering platforms, are preferred.

•

Leading large monorepos, build platforms supporting multiple languages, remote execution platforms, or enterprise developer productivity platforms.

•

Building AI-powered code review, test generation, incident diagnosis, or automated remediation systems and validating them in production.

•

Operating large environments spanning hosts and containers, improving software supply chain security, or contributing to relevant open-source projects.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

•

L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company events

•

Wellness and meal allowances

•

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

•

The Pepperstone story started in 2010. We know what it’s like to trade the world’s markets. Our team describes us as a place for the curious and the driven, and we like to do things a little differently; as a transformative global fintech we’re digital, nimble, connected and united in our vision to create a better way to trade.

We thrive on progress – for our clients and for ourselves. Our organisational culture is ever-evolving, vibrant, diverse, global and results focused.

You’ll find our 700+ team currently across 12 locations and 9 time zones.

The Role
Our technology team thrives on inclusivity and collaboration, believing that diverse perspectives lead to great solutions. We foster a culture that champions individual growth, professional development, and work-life harmony. We're invested in your success and dedicated to supporting you every step of the way. We encourage our team to bring challenge thinking and fresh ideas to the table and our Agile approach empowers us to focus on outcomes. When we hire someone it's because they bring the skills, attitude and experience we're looking for....so we let you do what you're best at! Join us and be part of a community that's passionate about harnessing technology's potential to drive market leading solutions for our clients. Elevate your career in an environment where your ideas matter, your growth is nurtured, and your potential is limitless.

Our clients in more than 160 countries compare Pepperstone’s trading app, web trader and client area with the best consumer and fintech products they use every day. We want to set that bar higher. You’ll be the most senior hands-on engineer across our client-facing products, reporting directly to the CTO and providing senior technical leadership while remaining deeply hands-on.

As our Senior Principal Engineer - Platform Engineering, your key responsibilities include but may not be limited to:
• Shape our platform technical direction: Define the multi-year architecture across AI, cloud, networking, identity and data. You’ll help engineers and leaders navigate complex technical trade-offs and align around a clear direction, while identifying scaling, cost and resilience risks before they become issues.
• Stay hands-on with our toughest engineering challenges: Work directly on the most critical parts of our platform, writing production code and infrastructure as code and prototyping new approaches. You’ll take the lead on complex challenges across low-latency connectivity, high-throughput streaming, large data and identity migrations and platform reliability.
• Lead and shape AI-native engineering: Help design the core of Pepperstone’s AI platform, from model access and agent orchestration to tool connections, retrieval, evaluation and runtime governance. You’ll use AI coding and agent tools in your day-to-day work while helping establish the patterns, workflows and guardrails that enable our engineers to do the same.
• Create a great developer experience: Design the paved roads that make it easier for our engineers to build and ship, spanning service templates, CI/CD, observability, secrets, infrastructure as code and the developer platform. You’ll treat the platform as a product, using adoption and developer experience to help shape what we build next.
• Grow our technical capability: Mentor senior and staff engineers and help build an inclusive engineering community across locations. You’ll also contribute to hiring senior engineering talent and help set the bar for technical interviews.
• Partner with our technology leaders: Act as a trusted technical advisor to the CTO and Technology leadership team, bringing an independent, hands-on perspective to complex technical decisions. You’ll help ensure security, resilience, data protection and regulatory requirements are considered from the outset.

About you
• You bring extensive experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems and platforms with proven Staff or Principal-level impact within a scaled technology, SaaS or fintech environment.
• You’re still deeply hands-on, writing production code and infrastructure as code, reviewing code and prototyping solutions.
• You bring deep expertise across two or three areas such as AI platforms, cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, global networking, identity and authorisation or data and streaming platforms, with the ability to work credibly across the broader platform landscape.
• You have practical production experience with AI platforms, including LLM APIs, agent orchestration, retrieval, evaluation and AI observability, alongside AI-assisted engineering in your own day-to-day work.
• You understand how to build platforms as products, creating paved roads and developer experiences that are adopted and valued across multiple teams.
• You have experience running always-on, highly available systems and bring strong instincts around reliability, observability, performance and cost.
• You’ve successfully influenced technical direction across multiple teams without relying on direct authority, building trust through strong communication, technical judgement and collaboration.
• You’ve led significant migrations across live platforms and understand how to deliver change without disrupting the teams and clients that rely on them.
• You communicate complex technical decisions clearly to engineers, executives and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy mentoring senior and staff engineers.
• Experience with low-latency trading, market data, payments infrastructure, high-throughput streaming or identity and security at scale would be valuable but isn’t essential.

Why you will enjoy working with us
• Competitive salary structure including company bonus scheme
• Genuinely collaborative and friendly culture
• Flexible and hybrid working
• Remote working option - work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year, in addition to hybrid working as standard
• Ongoing personal development & learning opportunities
• 15 weeks paid primary carers parental leave & 4 weeks paid secondary carers leave
• 3 paid volunteering days per year & Workplace Giving Program
• Frequent events and celebrations including a standard weekly social
• Beautifully renovated large office at Collins Square - 727 Collins Street, Melbourne
• Best in class end of trip facilities including bicycle parking, change rooms & showers
• A full stocked kitchen, onsite coffee machines with locally sourced coffee beans (this is Melbourne after all) and curated specialty teas

More About Pepperstone
We’re a regulated online Forex and CFD trading platform. With the scale of a global fintech and the agility of a start-up, we arm our clients with everything they need to take on the global markets with confidence. You will be part of a wider passionate and friendly team, and whilst things may not always go to plan, we learn quickly and move forward with impact. To learn even more visit Pepperstonecareers and www.linkedin.com/company/pepperstone/
We understand it’s important to do due diligence on a prospective employer, see what our team are saying on Glassdoor. We respect our team members’ experiences and will never pay to remove a negative review.
Pepperstone is an equal opportunity employer. We are passionate about building a diverse workplace and strongly encourage applications from any background.
“We are a 2025 Circle Back Initiative Employer – we respond to every applicant”.
We will be reviewing applications as they come through, so if this is an opportunity that excites you, don't wait. Express your interest by clicking the apply button below as soon as possible.
Note to external agencies: While we appreciate the efforts of external recruitment agencies, we prefer to engage directly with applicants for this opportunity.

We're looking for our next Compliance Officer, Business Compliance. Could It Be You?

Growth Portfolio is seeking a motivated Compliance Officer to support the day-to-day administration of compliance programs for Zolo Ventures Ltd. and its provincial real estate brokerages: Zolo Realty (Ontario) Inc., Zolo Realty (Alberta) Inc., and Zolo Realty (BC) Inc.

In this role you will manage Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL) and Unsolicited Telecommunications Rules (UTRs) compliance programs, Anti-Money Laundering (AML/FINTRAC) automation initiatives, website digital compliance auditing, and the lifecycle administration and annual renewal tracking of provincial entity licences and regulated role registries. You will drive CASL and UTR monitoring, testing, complaint handling, and training across a distributed network of independent real estate agents and brokerages.

You will work closely with Business and Product leadership, with guidance from the Brokers of Record, to ensure that digital marketplace campaigns, lead-routing disclosures, and listing data displays comply with all statutory standards before they reach consumers.

Need more details? Keep reading…

In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:

•

Managing and executing company-wide compliance programs covering CASL, CRTC UTRs, AML/FINTRAC requirements, and website digital compliance across all web and mobile platforms

•

Leading initiatives to automate AML/FINTRAC identity verification, KYC checks, and transaction monitoring, working cross-functionally with Operations, Product, Technology, and Engineering teams

•

Conducting systematic audits of customer-facing website user journeys, lead-capture forms, disclaimers, terms of service, and automated marketing flows

•

Establishing and managing Existing Business Relationship (EBR) verification and National Do Not Call List (DNCL) access controls within CRM and marketing systems

•

Maintaining, reviewing, and updating compliance policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and tiered disciplinary frameworks, and escalating material non-compliance or red-flag risks to executive leadership

•

Assisting with the triage, investigation, and resolution of consumer and regulatory complaints (CRTC, RECO, RECA, BCFSA, FSRA, Privacy), maintaining audit-ready records

•

Designing and delivering compliance training and awareness modules for independent contractor agents, brokerages, and mortgage representatives across Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and other provinces, and tracking adherence

•

Managing reporting inputs for senior management, affiliate Compliance Committees, and regulatory authorities

•

Monitoring legal and regulatory changes to assess operational impacts and recommend necessary adjustments

•

Reviewing consumer data storage protocols and third-party API data sharing, such as lead routing to partner brokerages, to guarantee legal consent compliance

•

Auditing and maintaining Zolo's public-facing Privacy Policy and Terms of Use

•

Managing and maintaining the master register of all regulated entities, provincial brokerage licences, and statutory roles, including Brokers of Record, Managing Brokers, Alternate/Secondary Brokers of Record, Branch Managers, and Principal Mortgage Brokers across Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and other operating jurisdictions

•

Monitoring and coordinating annual licensing renewal cycles, corporate regulatory filings, RECO/BCFSA/RECA/FSRA portal roster updates (such as RECO MyWeb, BCFSA IRIS, and myRECA), fee processing, and mandatory continuing education (CE) compliance for all designated brokerage leaders and corporate entities

•

Building working knowledge of CASL, the UTRs, and CRTC guidance, and developing an understanding of the regulatory landscape governing residential real estate brokerages and, ideally, mortgage brokerages in Canada (RECO, RECA, BCFSA, FSRA)

•

Investigating cases and performing initial case analysis to support senior compliance staff

•

Finding and implementing efficiencies using AI and other technology

•

Adhering to Questrade's and Zolo's compliance policies and procedures

So are YOU our next Compliance Officer, Business Compliance? You are if you…

•

Have a four-year post-secondary degree and 3–4 years of relevant compliance, financial services, or regulated-industry experience

•

Are proficient in Microsoft Excel and other data management tools

•

Have exceptional verbal and written communication skills, and can communicate clearly and professionally to a range of audiences, including independent contractor agents and senior stakeholders

•

Have strong organizational and time-management skills, and can manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment with regulatory deadlines

•

Demonstrate analytical, problem-solving, and investigative skills, with the attention to detail needed for accurate monitoring, testing, and recordkeeping, and can manage sensitive matters with discretion

•

Exercise sound judgment in day-to-day compliance matters, and know when to escalate issues to senior compliance staff

•

Collaborate effectively with diverse teams and individuals across business units

•

Have a working understanding of CRM, marketing technology, telephony, and related systems used to support consumer communications

•

Have a demonstrated interest in building a career in compliance, and are eager to develop deeper regulatory expertise over time

•

Bring the highest level of ethics, accountability, and professionalism to your work

Additional kudos if you…

•

Have familiarity with CASL and/or UTR requirements

•

Have exposure to residential real estate or mortgage brokerage regulation

•

Join Saxo, as a Senior Product Owner to help shape the digital experience behind Saxo's Global Website.

About the Job
We are looking for a highly structured and analytical Senior Product Owner to help shape and evolve the digital experience of Saxo’s global website – Home.saxo. Our global website is an essential part of our customer journey.

You will work across marketing, business and technology, to collaborate closely with designers, web operations, engineering, content, SEO/GEO, CRO, media, analytics, and local website owners across our 11 markets.

Your role is to turn ideas, customer needs and business priorities into clear product direction and scalable digital solutions for Home.saxo – taking initiatives from concept through to implementation and continuous improvement.

The role comes with significant ownership and autonomy. You will own day-to-day product priorities, form clear recommendations, and make decisions within your area. You will work closely with the Head of Websites and Owned Media and senior stakeholders on strategic priorities and major trade-offs.

As a Senior Product Owner, you will join the Websites & Owned Media department reporting directly to the Head of Websites and Owned Media. The department sits in Saxo’s global marketing organization and brings together 30 passionate and skilled individuals from various cultures and countries. Together we work dynamically across Web Operations, UX/UI, SEO/GEO, CRO, content and engineering, to create a globally consistent but locally relevant Home.saxo experience.

You will work with a variety of global and local stakeholders across the business, to turn customer and business needs into scalable digital solutions and continuously improve how we build, manage and optimise Saxo's websites globally.

Responsibilities
· Own and drive the website product roadmap & capabilities, setting priorities and making clear trade-offs based on customer value, business impact, effort, risk and strategic priorities.
· Bridge experience and execution, working with design, business, engineering and web operations to turn concepts into scalable solutions, clear implementation requirements and reusable capabilities.
· Translate concepts into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that development teams can act on.
· Work with engineering and solution architects to challenge, refine and validate solutions, ensuring they are scalable and fit for purpose.
· Ensure solutions support global consistency and local relevance, with clear principles, components and guidelines that enable web operations and market website owners to adopt and scale them.
· Drive UAT and release readiness, ensuring solutions meet experience, functional, accessibility, content and business requirements – including proper documentation.
· Use data, customer insights, and experimentation to measure impact and continuously improve website experience.
· Ensure accessibility is considered throughout the product lifecycle, and that website capabilities align with WCAG standards and regulatory requirements.

Your Profile
We are looking for a Senior Digital Product professional who combines customer focus, commercial understanding, and technical confidence. Ideally, you have experience within several of the following:

· 7+ years of experience in digital product management, website development, digital experience, marketing, or a similar field.
· Experience as a technical Product Manager, Product Owner or similar, working across business, design and engineering.
· Experience with complex websites, CMS platforms, or digital ecosystems. Sitecore or a comparable enterprise CMS is highly desirable.
· A solid understanding of web technology and architecture, including APIs, content rendering, caching, frontend/backend integration and key web performance concepts such as Core Web Vitals.
· Experience translating concepts and designs into scalable digital solutions and components.
· Stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate competing priorities, challenge constructively and make clear recommendations.
· Experience working in a global organisation, balancing global consistency with local market needs.
· Experience within the financial sector is a plus.

As a person, you are curious, highly structured, and pragmatic. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and excel at breaking down complex business challenges into clear problem statements, desired outcomes, and actionable opportunities. You are comfortable making decisions and taking ownership. As well as turning concepts into reality by focusing on the details needed, to turn an idea into something that works in practice.

You recognise when broader alignment or senior stakeholder input is needed and are confident in navigating different perspectives to move things forward.

Furthermore, you are open to new ways of working, including AI-powered tools, and look for opportunities to automate repetitive tasks, improve quality, and focus on higher-value work.

We look forward to receiving your application.
